name: Swift Block Super 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev, Core Magnets)
description: The Swift Block Super 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev, Core Magnets) is a levitation-driven speed cube built around a dual-ring MagLev system and an omni-directional core, tuned for instant acceleration and a light, frictionless glide. At 71g with 8-gear tension adjustment, it's a fast, tunable magnetic speed cube that stays stable through fast turns.
features: Snaps into place: 76 magnets deliver 3D surround magnetic force, pulling each turn into alignment and drifting misaligned layers back within about 35 degrees.
Light in the hand: At 71g, it's easy to hold and quick to control, so your fingers stay fast through long solves.
GES tension system: Adjust handfeel across 8 gears to move from loose and flowing to firm and controlled.
Continuously variable center travel: Fine-tune the core beyond the fixed gears for a setup that's genuinely yours.
Omni-directional core: An omni-support spherical orbit keeps the tuning stable, so your dialed-in feel holds up turn after turn.
Dual ring magnets: Friction-reducing repulsion lifts each layer while attraction speed-boosts the turn back into place.
